provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: CABO (Second Edition) rules (Bezier Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Shuffle; deal each player 4 cards facedown in a line
Deck facedown in the middle; flip its top card to start the discard pile
Each player secretly looks at any 2 of their own cards, once
steps.note: Cards in your line never change places

steps.text: Only cards drawn from the deck use abilities: 7-8 peek, 9-10 spy, 11-12 swap
Calling CABO: lowest sum scores 0; otherwise your sum +10
Kamikaze: exactly two 12s and two 13s scores 0 and everyone else 50
Landing on exactly 100 resets you to 50, once per game; over 100 ends the game
Random start player; then the round's lowest scorer starts the next round
